The Grubhub Merchant Schedules API allows partners to manage restaurant operating hours and availability on the Grubhub Marketplace. It supports setting regular business hours for delivery, pickup, and catering, temporary closures, schedule overrides, and special holiday schedules. Partners can check merchant availability status and update schedules to ensure customers see accurate ordering windows for each restaurant location.
